messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU_POOL_SATURATION detected for customer cluster acme-eta (private-vpc). queue_length > 95% for 7m. severity=high. incident_id=INC-2026-3141. paging oncall.
kumar (oncall): I'm on it. Joining. Starting timeline + metric snapshots.
maria (SRE): seeing heavy queue growth on acme-eta inference-queue, tokens/sec spiking. GPUs at 100% and autoscaler desired count=12 but max_nodes=8. autoscaler logs show quota constraint refusal.
joel (infra): Confirmed. Provider quota for project acme-eta is 8 GPU nodes (hard limit). This explains desired>max. Customer hasn't requested increase.
kumar (oncall): Immediate customer impact? Are requests failing or just high latency?
customer-support: Preliminary numbers: ~2.3k requests returned 503s over the last 10 minutes, error spike aligns with queue backlog. Some customers reporting timeouts. We've opened a CS ticket and messaged the customer.
natalie (eng): If we can route non-sensitive traffic off their private cluster to hosted, we can relieve pressure quickly. Can we do a partial route failover?
deploy-bot: routing change submitted: route(acme-eta)->hosted-fallback-small rollout=30% -> 100% over 10m. change_id=rout-3141
maria (SRE): Good. Also turning on aggressive KV/prefix caching for acme to reduce repeated context loads. Patch below:

```
# apply caching config
kubectl -n acme-eta patch cm inference-config --patch '{"data":{"prefix_cache":"enabled","cache_ttl":"60s"}}'
```

maria (SRE): Autoscaler logs (excerpt):
```
2026-03-14T14:12:05Z autoscaler ERROR desired=12 max=8 constraint=quota provider_response="quota_exceeded"
2026-03-14T14:12:30Z provisioner WARN waiting for image pull slower than expected (customer region eu-west-3)
2026-03-14T14:13:10Z autoscaler INFO backoff=30s
```
joel (infra): Customer quota can't be raised immediately (customer says they can't change provider quota until Monday). We need internal mitigation.
kumar (oncall): Options: A) soft-fail to hosted (already rolling), B) create emergency nodes from our dedicated/burst pool and attach to their VPC (possible but requires NAT/networking ops), C) throttle non-essential requests at edge.
maria (SRE): Recommend C + A as fastest. Also I'll attempt to provision 2 aux nodes from dedicated-pool as B fallback; ETA ~7-9m if network glue works.
dave (ops-runner): I'll prep the network ACLs and IP allocation. FYI many image pulls slowed due to image registry throttling; might need to pre-warm images.

# manual node create (maria):
```
# create emergency nodepool with two gpus
redwoodctl nodepool create --project dedicated-burst --name acme-aux --nodes 2 --labels=customer=acme-eta
```

deploy-bot: nodepool create request accepted: node-ids=[node-aux-1,node-aux-2]
maria (SRE): Node bootstrap logs show CNI failures, kubelet not joining initially. snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T14:17:02Z] kubelet ERROR unable to allocate pod IP: ipam: no available addresses
```
dave (ops-runner): Looks like VPC IP exhaustion on customer's subnet. Running ipam reclamation.

```
# reclaim unused ENIs / addresses (dry-run first)
sudo ipamctl reclaim --vpc acme-eta --dry-run
sudo ipamctl reclaim --vpc acme-eta --force
```

dave (ops-runner): reclaimed ~45 IPs, resolved CNI failures. kubelet registered, nodes joined.
maria (SRE): pods scheduling onto node-aux-1/2, RPS handling improving. Queue depth dropping from 12k -> 3.2k in 12m. Good sign.
customer-support: CS update: customer notified. They saw degraded service ~14:08-14:20 UTC. We'll send incident summary and apology. they asked for ETA on full recovery.
kumar (oncall): Tell them we're in mitigation: routing + caching + 2 aux nodes. Monitoring for 30m; ETA for stable state ~20-30m. Adding followups: request provider quota bump for them and add automated detection to alert when desired>max for >3m.
joel (infra): I'll create an infra ticket to implement 'preflight quota check' for private clusters and a runbook to auto-request ephemeral nodes from dedicated-burst when private cluster quota blocks scaling.

maria (SRE): Action items captured:
- keep routing fallback live until queue < 5% for 60m (maria)
- file infra ticket for quota preflight + policy (joel)
- customer follow-up and SLA impact calc (customer-support)
- add detection alert and runbook (kumar)

kumar (oncall): Oncall handoff: I'll be handing off to joel in 2 hours. Marking incident status: mitigated -> partial. We'll keep monitoring. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-3141 status=partial_mitigation. Impact reduced. Postmortem requested. Labels: customer-impact, autoscaler, private-vpc, quota
